te: Roman Emperor Gratian is murdered at a banquet after having surrendered to the forces of rival emperor Magnus Maximus.
dz: 罗马皇帝格拉提安在向对手皇帝马格努斯·马克西穆斯(英语:Magnus Maximus)的军队投降后在宴会被谋杀.
